description: Makes one output with a model from compute_catalog: text (prompt, system?, max_tokens?), image (prompt, size?, count?), video (prompt, aspect?, resolution?), voice (text, voice?), music (prompt, lyrics?, seconds?, instrumental?) or 3D (image: an upload id from POST /api/compute/uploads). Paid per call: the call without payment answers with the payment request. Pay by signing one USDG transferWithAuthorization (EIP-3009) for exactly the amount and payee the payment request names, and send the same call again with it in _meta["x402/payment"] (MCP) or the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (HTTP). No gas: this site settles it. Paid up front: if the output fails, the payment goes back to the payer automatically, less what its upstream charged when the model’s safety check turns the prompt down, or when a text model given a max_tokens under the default ends with only its thinking. Returns the output (text inline, files as links on this site that expire within the hour), the receipt with its settlement hash, and for enclave models whether the enclave receipt checks out. Long outputs answer with the job id: read them with compute_status.

image.description: 3D models: an upload id from POST /api/compute/uploads (a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB).

instrumental.description: Music models that take it: no vocals.

lyrics.description: Music models that sing: the lyrics.

max_tokens.description: Text models: the answer budget, in tokens (default 2048). A reasoning model thinks within it before it answers, and runs with at least 1024. If it ends with only thinking on a budget set under 2048, what comes back is the price less what its upstream billed.

mode.description: auto or cheapest (the lowest price), fastest, or secure (only a hardware enclave that signs a receipt).

prompt.description: What to make (text, image and video models).

resolution.description: Video: 480p or 720p (where the model offers both). 3D (TRELLIS 2): 512, 1024 or 1536.

seconds.description: Music models that take a length: the track, in seconds.

size.description: Image models: square (default), landscape or portrait.

text.description: Voice models: the text to speak.

voice.description: Voice models: warm (default), bright, deep or calm.

name: compute_generate
title: Make an output (paid)
